'''Mex Briggam''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Czerka Interstellar]] employee and [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief Engineer]]<ref name="Op" /> in [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="Year">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref> Briggam assisted the [[CI-004 Incident|operation]] of a ground team into [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun's]] [[CI-004 Research Facility]].<ref name="Op" />
